title: YouTube end screen
slide_intent: Make an ending offer further choices so the viewing path continues without hiding its source.
strategic_value: A branded end screen can connect Channel 4’s sport clips with other material on an external platform.
demonstration: A YouTube page shows a gradient end screen with a 4 Sport roundel at left, Subscribe above and two video suggestions at right.
practical_value: Balance a subscription request with specific next-video choices.

content_islands.name: Brand and invitation
content_islands.spec: Keep the roundel and Subscribe prompt within the gradient field.

content_islands.name: Suggested videos
content_islands.spec: Stack two recommendation thumbnails on the right inside the player.

content_islands.name: Platform context
content_islands.spec: Retain the browser and YouTube chrome to show the external setting.

reference_purposes.Application: The brand is applied to a YouTube subscription and recommendation end screen.
